title: Dune
creator: Frank Herbert
synopsis: A noble family takes over a desert planet that holds the universe's most valuable resource, and a young heir finds himself at the centre of a prophecy.
notes: Reread. The appendices reward the patience.

title: The Name of the Wind
creator: Patrick Rothfuss
synopsis: Kvothe, now an innkeeper, tells the true story of how a gifted orphan became a legend, from a travelling troupe to the University.

title: Project Hail Mary
creator: Andy Weir
synopsis: A lone astronaut wakes up on a ship with no memory of why he is there, and slowly works out that he is humanity's last chance.
notes: Finished it in two sittings. Rocky is the best character of the year.

title: Piranesi
creator: Susanna Clarke
synopsis: Piranesi lives in a house of endless halls, tides and statues, and keeps careful journals until a stranger's arrival disturbs his world.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
creator: Ursula K. Le Guin
synopsis: An envoy to a frozen world of people with no fixed gender tries to persuade its kingdoms to join an interstellar alliance.
notes: Slow start, but I want to get back to it in winter.

title: Klara and the Sun
creator: Kazuo Ishiguro
synopsis: Klara, an Artificial Friend, watches the world from a shop window and hopes to be chosen by a child who needs her.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
creator: Brandon Sanderson
synopsis: A street thief discovers she can burn metals for superhuman power and joins a crew plotting to overthrow an immortal emperor.

title: Norwegian Wood
creator: Haruki Murakami
synopsis: A man looks back on his student years in Tokyo and the fragile woman who tied him to his dead friend.
notes: Not the right time. Might try Kafka on the Shore instead.

title: Blade Runner 2049
creator: Denis Villeneuve
synopsis: A new blade runner unearths a secret that could plunge what remains of society into chaos, and goes looking for a missing predecessor.

title: Spirited Away
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
synopsis: A girl stumbles into a bathhouse for spirits and must work there to free her parents and find her way home.

title: Parasite
creator: Bong Joon-ho
synopsis: A poor family schemes its way into the employ of a wealthy household, with consequences nobody planned for.

title: Past Lives
creator: Celine Song
synopsis: Two childhood friends separated by emigration reunite decades later for one week in New York.

title: Arrival
creator: Denis Villeneuve
synopsis: A linguist is recruited to find out why twelve alien ships have landed, and how to talk to the visitors.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
creator: Wes Anderson
synopsis: A legendary concierge and his lobby boy are caught up in the theft of a priceless painting and a fight over a family fortune.

title: Dune: Part Two
creator: Denis Villeneuve
synopsis: Paul Atreides joins the Fremen and sets out on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
notes: Seen in IMAX. The sound design alone was worth it.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
creator: Daniel Kwan, Daniel Scheinert
synopsis: A laundromat owner is pulled into a multiverse conflict where the only way to win is to connect with the people she loves.

title: In the Mood for Love
creator: Wong Kar-wai
synopsis: Two neighbours in 1960s Hong Kong discover that their spouses are having an affair, and grow close in the shadow of it.

title: Severance
creator: Dan Erickson
synopsis: Employees at a mysterious company have their work and personal memories surgically divided, until one of them starts asking what the work is for.

title: Breaking Bad
creator: Vince Gilligan
synopsis: A high-school chemistry teacher diagnosed with cancer turns to making methamphetamine to secure his family's future.

title: The Bear
creator: Christopher Storer
synopsis: A young chef returns to Chicago to run his late brother's sandwich shop, and its chaotic kitchen crew.

title: Chernobyl
creator: Craig Mazin
synopsis: A dramatisation of the 1986 nuclear disaster and the sacrifices made by those who contained it.

title: Succession
creator: Jesse Armstrong
synopsis: The Roy family, owners of a global media empire, jockey for control as their patriarch's health declines.

title: Dark
creator: Baran bo Odar, Jantje Friese
synopsis: The disappearance of two children in a German town exposes the secrets of four families across several generations.

title: Westworld
creator: Jonathan Nolan, Lisa Joy
synopsis: In a futuristic theme park staffed by lifelike androids, the hosts begin to question the loops they have been written into.
notes: Season one was brilliant. After season two I lost the thread.

title: Cowboy Bebop
creator: Shinichirō Watanabe
synopsis: A crew of bounty hunters drifts through the solar system, chasing payouts and running from their pasts.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
creator: Bones
synopsis: Two brothers search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore the bodies they lost to a forbidden alchemical ritual.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
creator: Madhouse
synopsis: After defeating the Demon King, an elf mage sets out to understand the human companions whose lives passed in a blink.

title: Attack on Titan
creator: Wit Studio, MAPPA
synopsis: Humanity lives behind giant walls to hide from man-eating Titans, until a breach sends one boy on a quest for answers.

title: Steins;Gate
creator: White Fox
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist discovers a way to send messages to the past and unravels the consequences.

title: Mob Psycho 100
creator: Bones
synopsis: A middle-schooler with immense psychic power tries to live a normal life and keep his emotions in check.

title: Death Note
creator: Madhouse
synopsis: A student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, and a genius detective sets out to stop him.

title: Vinland Saga
creator: Wit Studio, MAPPA
synopsis: A young Viking raised on revenge joins the band that killed his father, and slowly learns what it would mean to have no enemies.
